state.latest_reply: A pipe burst under the kitchen sink last night. There is water all over the floor and it is still dripping into the cupboard below.

next_field.instructions: Which empty field of the form should the assistant ask about next? Ask first about what matters most for the person right now, given state.filled and state.latest_reply.

criteria.emergency_help: Whether the damage is still happening and the person needs an emergency repair sent now
criteria.incident_date: The exact date and time the damage happened, when the person has not given it
criteria.damaged_items: A list of what was damaged and roughly what it is worth
criteria.repair_quote: A quote or invoice from a repairer
criteria.ready_to_submit: Nothing more is needed now; the claim can be submitted
criteria.needs_person: The person is upset, confused or describing something the form cannot capture, so hand over to a claims handler
